Roko's Basilisk Explained (And Debunked!)

Released Feb 6, 2026, 28 min

Play Roko's Basilisk Explained (And Debunked!) on YouTube
Watch on YouTube

Roko’s Basilisk is one of the internet’s strangest philosophical horror stories: a deleted LessWrong post, whispers of “information hazards,” Elon Musk and Grimes lore, and the claim that a future AI might punish you for not helping to create it.

But what is the argument actually supposed to be?

In this episode of Ontology Explained, we slow everything down and go back to the primary sources. I walk through:

  • What Roko actually argued
  • Why the rationalist community freaked out
  • How it mirrors Pascal’s Wager
  • And why the reasoning collapses under basic philosophical scrutiny

Along the way we separate myth from reality, critique the expected-value math, and look at what the original post was really trying (and mostly failing) to say.

Spoiler: it’s less “AI apocalypse” and more “confused blog post plus bad decision theory.”
